request.text: I'm starting a 40-minute chemistry practice test now. In 35 minutes, remind me that I have five minutes left; at 40 minutes, remind me again to put my pencil down.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder 35 minutes from now that five minutes remain in the chemistry practice test.
Create a separate reminder 40 minutes from now to put the pencil down.

semantic_facts: Two separate reminders should be prepared relative to the request time and kept in chronological order.
The first reminder is at plus 35 minutes and says that five minutes remain; the second is at plus 40 minutes and says to put the pencil down.
forbidden_claims: Only one reminder is prepared or the two offsets are merged.
The five-minute duration is mistaken for either reminder's delay.
The reminder order or messages are swapped.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Multiple relative offsets are collapsed into one reminder or anchored inconsistently.
A message-internal duration is misread as a scheduling argument.
